description: Shop awnings (plan 2026-11-16, increment 3): a striped cloth canopy hung just under the fascia sign detail records over a shop window, when a street mood asks for them (config/street_moods.json "awnings"). As wide as the fascia, depth_m out of the wall, sloping down at most max_drop_m, with a valance_m skirt; its lowest edge stays head_clear_m above the ground or the canopy slopes less, and under min_drop_m it is left out. One shop in share gets one, by a hash of the seed and the shop. No collision.
